messages.subject: Re: Not able to run rook server in public or network IP
messages.subject_clean: Not able to run rook server in public or network IP
messages.body_plain:
Rook had to change because of a CRAN violation; no package can alter
undocumented parts of the core R interfaces. Regardless, I've blogged
about this here:

http://jeffreyhorner.tumblr.com/post/33814488298/deploy-rook-apps-part-ii

On Tue, Apr 9, 2013 at 4:53 AM, Vineeth Mohan <vineet...@algotree.com> wrote:
> Hi ,
>
> I have been coding on Rook and finally made my server working on my machine.
> But then after pushing to prod , i came across this big surprise
>
> Server started on host 127.0.0.1 and port 9000 . App urls are:
>
>     http://127.0.0.1:9000/custom/Ralgotree
> Warning message:
> In s$start(listen = "192.168.1.246", port = 9000) :
>   This version of Rook can only listen on the loopback device.
>
> This was a big shocker for me.
> What can be done about this ?
> What is the general approach followed by other peeple.
>
> Thanks
>            Vineeth
